old: Skull Rock gruyère and pepper puffs

dish.note: Cheddar scones with a pinch of mustard, split warm and buttered, for Tiger Lily's rescue.
dish.how: Heat the oven to 220C. Rub 60g cold butter into 300g self-raising flour with 1 tsp mustard powder and a pinch of salt, stir in 100g grated cheddar and mix to a soft dough with 200ml milk. Pat out 2cm thick, cut 10 rounds, brush with milk and top with a little more cheese. Bake 12 to 14 minutes until risen and golden. Split warm and butter.
dish.make_ahead: Best baked on the night; rub in the butter up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C and rub the butter into the flour, mustard and salt.
Stir in most of the cheese and mix to a soft dough with the milk.
Pat out, cut rounds, brush with milk and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake until risen and golden, then split warm and butter.
